summary: Label Generation Rulesets (LGRs) are the rules that decide which identifier labels are valid and which alternative forms, called variants, are related, as in Internationalized Domain Names. This document gives guidance on how to design LGRs that handle variant labels sensibly.

eli5.summary: Some words can be written in more than one way that look or mean the same. This gives rule-makers advice on how to treat those look-alike spellings fairly.

questions: how to handle idn variant labels
